spanish: Habla a Aarón y a sus hijos, diciendo: Esta torá del pecado; en lugar que se degüella el holocausto se degollará el pecado delante de Jehová; santidad de santidades ella.

findings.issue: Common noun תּוֹרַת (H8451, construct; not a proper name) is left as the untranslated loan torá.
Both verbs are niphal imperfect 3fs, but Spanish uses present se degüella for the first and future se degollará for the second.
findings.spanishSpan: se degüella el holocausto se degollará

notes: Remaining tokens match, including Jehová, the repeated חַטָּאת as pecado, and verbless קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים הִוא.
